Upserts draft evaluation scores.
Rules:
- If existing evaluation and round is CLOSED: returns 409 ROUND_CLOSED (MSG-19).
- If no existing evaluation and round is not OPEN: returns 404 Not Found.
- If evaluation already SUBMITTED: returns 409 ALREADY_EVALUATED (MSG-17).
- If evaluator expired and starting a new applicant: returns 422 EVALUATOR_EXPIRED_NEW_APPLICANT (MSG-18).
- Concurrency & No-op: If payload equals DB exactly, returns 200 without updating DB or updatedAt. If clientUpdatedAt is older than DB updatedAt, returns 409 STALE_VERSION.
